Work.desc: Four projects where the hard decisions mattered more than the framework. Consistency, scale and product — with engineering evidence.

vanguarda.tagline: A core banking transfer service that never corrupts a balance.
vanguarda.summary: Account-to-account transfers built around three invariants: idempotency on retry, consistency under contention and an auditable ledger. SERIALIZABLE transactions, deterministically ordered distributed locks and double-entry entries, provisioned with Terraform on AWS.

impact.label: concurrent threads with no balance corruption

wow.tagline: A franchise network running on software we own.
wow.summary: Five production applications — NestJS APIs and Angular panels — covering POS, digitally signed contracts, Brazilian electronic invoicing (NFS-e), BigQuery BI and a complaints hub. I replaced Pipefy with a native workflow engine and documented 247 engineering deliveries along the way.

alyra.tagline: A finance and life app with an assistant that actually executes.
alyra.summary: A React Native/Expo mobile product on a FastAPI backend. The assistant uses tool calling to operate the app in natural language: 55 tools, mandatory confirmation for destructive actions and a deterministic fallback path. Google/Apple sign-in, TOTP 2FA, RevenueCat subscriptions and Cloud Run delivery with canary releases and automatic rollback.

kybernus.tagline: Open-source scaffolding for backends that matter.
kybernus.summary: A TypeScript CLI that generates NestJS, Express, Spring Boot, FastAPI and Next.js projects with clean, hexagonal or MVC architecture — plus Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and AI-generated docs. Published on npm and adopted by 100+ developers in its first month.

girix.summary: Segmentation, sizing and territory planning on a Python/OR-Tools engine, an offline-first PWA for reps and a before-vs-after projection in BRL.

dayride.summary: Google Maps routing, Stripe subscriptions, installable PWA and transactional email with Resend.

trevi.tagline: Personal finance through a Telegram bot.
trevi.summary: A receipt photo becomes a transaction: Gemini OCR and NLP, a React dashboard and Postgres.

ecommerce.summary: Rotating refresh tokens in HttpOnly cookies, RBAC, Stripe webhooks and Docker deployment on AWS.

graviq.summary: CRM, projects, finance and DOCX/PDF contract generation with row-level security across every Supabase table.

veterano.tagline: Mentorship between senior students and freshmen.
veterano.summary: Azure microfrontends with a Kong API gateway, a BFF and services on Container Apps.

wow.summary: Owning the full lifecycle of a monorepo with 5 applications that run a franchise network: POS, customer area, management panel and APIs.
bullets: Delivered NFS-e invoicing end to end — RPS, per-CNPJ certificates, ledger and automatic provisioning — removing manual fiscal work.
Replaced Pipefy with an in-house workflow engine (pipes, forms, automations and permissions) while keeping operational parity with the legacy tool.
Built BigQuery BI dashboards used by the board: funnel, cash flow, ticket SLA, ratings and complaints.
Shipped an AI assistant with tool calling, RAG over Notion and a white-label console inside the product.

vivo.summary: Automation and data for B2B and B2C operations across southern Brazil.
bullets: Python pipelines cut daily backlog processing from ~20 min to under 10 s, with zero manual errors.
Strategic Next.js + FastAPI dashboard with Rust parsers, adopted by directors and managers at 4 major partners.
Modular ETL handling 500k+ records per month with atomic table swaps on SQL Server: zero downtime and 100% reliability.

nex.summary: Bespoke software for small businesses: websites, automations and AI integrations.
bullets: Rebrand and high-conversion landing page for Fábrica das Cópias.
AI agent automations for sales, prospecting and operational tasks.

Stack.desc: No logo wall. Everything here has been to production.

About.p1: I'm a software engineer based in Curitiba, studying Software Engineering at PUCPR. I started in 2022 with JavaScript, moved through Python, Java and TypeScript, and today I care about the problems that don't fit in a tutorial: concurrency, money and data that cannot be wrong.
About.p2: My relationship with software comes from football: repeated practice, reading the game and the stubbornness to not let a bug go. I spent a year in Utah, USA, where I became fluent in English and won a regional championship — and learned to adapt fast when the plan changes.
About.p3: Outside work I train, read about distributed systems and maintain open-source projects. The goal is simple: build software that solves a real problem and still holds up the next day.

principles.title: Evidence over opinion
principles.desc: Tests, metrics and logs. If I can't prove it, it isn't done.

principles.title: Simple until it hurts
principles.desc: The best abstraction is the one I didn't have to write.

principles.title: Own the problem
principles.desc: From schema to deploy. I don't push the bug to the next layer.
